title: thermos
text: thermos. Mom likes to have exactly 2 mugs of coffee each morning and we have a single cup brewer - I wanted to make both her cups - one in the mug and one in the thermos keeping hot and she can serve it as she wants it.  Works perfectly.  Keeps the coffee hot and tasty for about 4 hours - cooling off slowly occurs after that... but she usually drinks it before the 4 hour mark.  I have not used with cold drinks so I can't really remark on that.  It holds about 16 oz.  I do like how compact and easy it is.  I do recommend a bottle washer brush to help keep it clean - coffee is oily and sticks to stuff - including stainless.  It does go in the dishwasher too.
